name: VirusTotal
tagline: Multi-engine file, URL, domain, and IP reputation scanning for security analysis
description: VirusTotal aggregates antivirus engines, website scanners, and threat intelligence to analyze files, URLs, domains, and IP addresses. Its public API lets developers submit samples, retrieve multi-engine scan reports, and query reputation data used widely in security tooling and threat research.

auth.details: API key via x-apikey header; free key from VirusTotal account after signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public API: 4 req/min, 500 req/day (typical free-tier limits; verify on account)
pricing.paid_plans: Premium/enterprise API with higher quotas and additional endpoints

rate_limits: Public API commonly 4 requests/minute and 500/day; premium tiers higher — confirm in account/docs
use_cases: check file hash reputation across antivirus engines
scan a URL for multi-engine malware detection
get domain or IP threat intelligence report
submit a file for analysis and poll for results
retrieve relationship data (e.g. contacted domains for a sample)
